why: Enumeration-order control. Byte-identical file contents, swapped filenames, so the
definition that sorted last in the target run now sorts first.
If the reported winner flips, the winner is determined by enumeration order and the
policy rows must say so. If it does not flip, the winner is determined by something
else and the target run's result was not an artifact of how these files happened to
The swap is expressed as a rename map over the base fixture rather than as a second
copy of the content, so the two runs cannot drift apart.
